acceptanceCriteria: The offline span scorer is committed under `tools/retrieval-bench` (or its Go equivalent) with the exact invocation that reproduces every TCP-V0-029 number in the V1-0098 BUILD-LOG entry, or the entry labels the scorer NOT_PRODUCED and the numbers as not independently reproducible.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviews of the V1 wave-3 pull requests. Review of PR #99 (V1-0098): the worker labelled the scorer NOT_PRODUCED as committed code; the reviewer found it in the session scratchpad (v1-0098/score.py), reran it read-only and reproduced every number for all five subsets. Nothing in the repository can reproduce the TCP-V0-029 readings.
title: retrieval-bench: the TCP-V0-029 span scorer (`score.py`) is uncommitted, so the V1-0098 numbers reproduce only from a session scratchpad
